modules.title: What to Do After Water Damage
modules.description: Immediate actions to take when water damage occurs, safety considerations, and emergency response procedures
learningObjectives: Identify when to evacuate vs when it's safe to respond
Know how to stop common water sources
Understand insurance documentation requirements
Recognize the critical 24-48 hour window for action

modules.title: Understanding Your Insurance Claim
modules.description: Navigate the insurance claims process with confidence, understand coverage types, and work effectively with NRPG
learningObjectives: Understand different types of insurance coverage
Know what documentation is required for claims
Learn how NRPG works with insurers on your behalf
Understand excess payment and claim settlement process

modules.title: Choosing the Right Contractor
modules.description: Learn how to verify contractor credentials, recognize red flags, and understand what makes NRPG contractors uniquely qualified
learningObjectives: Understand why IICRC certification matters
Know how to verify contractor credentials
Recognize warning signs of unreliable contractors
Understand what makes NRPG contractors pre-vetted and trustworthy

modules.title: Fire Damage Recovery Process
modules.description: Understand fire and smoke damage restoration timelines, safety requirements, and living arrangements during recovery
learningObjectives: Understand fire damage restoration phases
Know realistic timelines (2 weeks to 6 months)
Learn about smoke odor removal requirements
Understand when temporary relocation is necessary

modules.title: Mold Remediation Explained
modules.description: Health risks of mold, when to call professionals, and the proper remediation process to prevent recurrence
learningObjectives: Recognize mold health risks and symptoms
Know when DIY is unsafe (>1 sqm, HVAC, health issues)
Understand professional remediation process
Learn prevention strategies for Australian climate

modules.title: Your Rights as a Property Owner
modules.description: Australian Consumer Law protections, warranty requirements, and dispute resolution options for restoration work
learningObjectives: Understand your rights under Australian Consumer Law
Know warranty requirements (minimum 12 months)
Learn dispute resolution pathways
Know when and how to contact Fair Trading or AFCA

modules.title: Emergency Preparedness & Prevention
modules.description: Protect your property before disaster strikes with emergency kits, maintenance schedules, and prevention strategies
learningObjectives: Prepare a comprehensive emergency kit
Create annual property maintenance schedule
Know essential emergency contacts
Implement disaster prevention strategies
Plan evacuation routes and procedures
